title: Durum 4: otelde (rezervasyon ve şikâyet)
intro: British: rezervasyon için günlük dilde booking denir. Twin room = iki tek yataklı oda, double room = çift kişilik yataklı oda, en suite «on [s{w}iit]» = odada banyo var. Şikâyeti kibarca, “I'm afraid…” veya “I'm sorry, but…” ile başlatın.

words.example: I have a booking under the name Yılmaz.
Please leave your key at reception.
A single room for three nights, please.
words.exampleTr: Üç gece için tek kişilik oda, lütfen.

words.example: We'd like a double room.
Is it a twin room or a double?
words.exampleTr: İki tek yataklı mı, çift yataklı mı?

words.example: All rooms are en suite.
Is breakfast included in the price?
What time is check-out?
Could I have a late check-out?

words.en: Can I leave my luggage here?
words.example: My flight is at nine. Can I leave my luggage here?
words.exampleTr: Uçağım dokuzda. Bagajımı burada bırakabilir miyim?

words.example: My key card isn't working.
I ordered room service.
The air conditioning doesn't work.

words.en: I'm afraid there's a problem with my room
words.tr: Maalesef odamla ilgili bir sorun var
words.example: I'm afraid there's a problem with my room.
words.exampleTr: Maalesef odamla ilgili bir sorun var.

words.example: The room is too noisy. It's next to the lift.

words.en: There are no towels in the room
words.example: Sorry, but there are no towels in the room.
words.exampleTr: Kusura bakmayın ama odada havlu yok.

words.example: Could I change rooms, please?

words.en: I'd like to speak to the manager
words.example: This isn't acceptable. I'd like to speak to the manager.
words.exampleTr: Bu kabul edilemez. Müdürle görüşmek istiyorum.

words.en: Could I have a wake-up call?
words.example: Could I have a wake-up call at six?

words.en: Could you call me a taxi?
words.example: Could you call me a taxi to the airport?
This isn't acceptable.
They upgraded us to a suite.
